description: Blind-crest two-way corridor (edge case 06) instantiated on richmond-field-station: 4 moving actors replayed from the render timeline (scene-state.v1 sampled at 24 fps over 0..6 s by `simforge render scene-state`; baked XODR heights, road + body attitude, wheel odometer) through `simforge-render job`: the committed document is lowered to the service's per-tick stream with groundY 0, so the baked heights are authoritative (the retired playback binary's --authored-height). Chase camera: the retired playback binary's follow camera (9 m behind, 3 m up, aimed 8 m ahead of the first actor, vertical FOV 58) as a rigid attach. Ticks 0..119 render; tick 60 is hashed. Gates: pass hashes, a non-vacuous instance-ID pass, and observed actor transforms within the Bevy parity profile of the timeline sampler. The motorcycle renders with its rider, posed from the timeline's wheelSpinRad odometer.
